meta.note: All four findings validated and implemented; full proof, publication, merge, and dashboard closure pending.

findings.title: Unsanitized filenames allow CI log-command injection

validation.rationale: Replace C0, C1, and Unicode line separators in displayed paths before the CI report is emitted; retain grouping on the original path.

remediation.summary: Replace C0, C1, and Unicode line separators in displayed paths before the CI report is emitted; retain grouping on the original path.

findings.title: Nightly updater exposes provider keys to install scripts

validation.rationale: Clear inherited environments for Git and Bun pre-start commands, allowlist HOME/PATH/CI for in-process maintenance, and disable lifecycle scripts on both install paths.

remediation.summary: Clear inherited environments for Git and Bun pre-start commands, allowlist HOME/PATH/CI for in-process maintenance, and disable lifecycle scripts on both install paths.

findings.title: Sibling discovery follows symlinks into unrelated Git clones

validation.rationale: Require each discovered sibling to have the same canonical and lexical path, excluding aliases to both source and unrelated clones.

remediation.summary: Require each discovered sibling to have the same canonical and lexical path, excluding aliases to both source and unrelated clones.

findings.title: Continuation lanes use attacker-controlled shared scratch files

validation.rationale: Let continuation lanes use the private user-cache default; validate ownership, permissions, and ancestors, reserve a unique mode-0700 run directory, and refuse output-file clobbering.

remediation.summary: Let continuation lanes use the private user-cache default; validate ownership, permissions, and ancestors, reserve a unique mode-0700 run directory, and refuse output-file clobbering.
